title: Split-pair-emptiness as the one consistency FORM behind four selection rules; the F15a no-go as the sole rigid leg

card.one_sentence_claim: A single consistency test -- a readout or selection predicate s descends through a declared quotient q iff its split-pair obstruction O={(x,x'): q(x)=q(x'), s(x)!=s(x')} is empty -- is the one closure/audit constraint behind conservation (constant on symmetry orbits), gauge-invariant observables (descent through A/G), no-symmetric-vacuum-selection (a nonempty obstruction forces an imported breaker), and one-sector-per-state superselection; but only the impossibility direction (the F15a no-go that an equivariant deterministic selector under a trivial orbit action lands solely in the common fixed locus) carries rigid physics, while every other leg imports its empirical content (the orbit, the unobservability bridge, sector-purity) and is opposite-world elastic.

QFT_SM (gauge theory: gauge-invariant observables / Wilson loops / Gribov-Singer; spontaneous symmetry breaking no-go)

card.shared_mechanism: Orbit-descent / split-pair-obstruction emptiness: the universal-algebra biconditional 'a function (or predicate) on the quotient = a function constant on fibers' specialized to a DECLARED group/route orbit quotient q. Formally (F2 def:split-pair; F15a def:selection-obstruction): rF descends through q iff splitObs(q,F,r)={(x,x'): q(x)=q(x'), rF(x)!=rF(x')}=empty, equivalently iff there exists barF with barF o q = rF. A selection rule (conserved / physical-observable / selected-vacuum / single-sector) holds iff the obstruction is empty; when nonempty the only F2 repairs are source refinement (declare a finer quotient / import a breaker b) or minimal target coarsening. The genuinely rigid corollary (F15a): if a selector sigma:O->X is equivariant and the G-action on the orbit set O is trivial, then for all g, rho_X(g,sigma(o))=sigma(o), so sigma(o) lies in the common G-fixed locus -- an equivariant deterministic chooser can only return symmetric points, never break a degenerate orbit.

card.minimum_viable_unification: A single Lean-anchored note that states the split-pair-emptiness consistency condition ONCE (F2 def:split-pair / F15a def:selection-obstruction), then exhibits four selection rules as instances on four declared quotients -- conservation (F27, q_orb), gauge-invariant observables (F18/F2 + OI-EI/Leibniz, A->A/G), the SSB no-go (F15a, vacuum orbit), and superselection (F9 + proposed-and-flagged F4, charge sectors) -- with ONE worked FINITE example per leg and a prominent scope fence declaring that (i) the group/quotient/bridge/sector-purity are imported, (ii) only the easy descent direction is captured for conservation/gauge/superselection, and (iii) the sole rigid, opposite-world-inelastic content is the F15a no-go that a symmetry cannot break itself.
card.why_scientists_care: It is a precise AUDIT of where the physics enters every selection rule: it separates, across four rules at once, the trivial descent bookkeeping (the same split-pair biconditional everywhere) from the exact imported datum each rule actually needs -- the orbit for conservation, the unobservability/OI-EI bridge for gauge, sector-purity for superselection, the declared breaker for SSB. For a methodologist or a foundations-of-physics reader this is a clean, Lean-anchored diagnostic of 'which textbook lemma is doing the work and what is being smuggled', and it isolates the single high-value open problem -- a DERIVED orbit/sector-selection principle plus an additive/cocycle obstruction structure -- whose solution would turn declarations into predictions. It must never be sold as deriving Noether, the gauge principle, or superselection, all of whose content is imported.

The domain_tension_ledger names 'quotient-by-fibers (orbit-descent, lumpability, gauge)' as exactly one of the three textbook lemmas SBT's mechanisms allegedly collapse to -- and U014's mechanism IS that lemma. Per-leg: (CM) recovers only the easy 'conserved iff invariant' half of Noether (R018 class A), not the deep symmetry-of-action => current direction, no J^mu, no enumeration; the group is imported. (Gauge) equal predictive content to the textbook gauge principle, strictly weaker on the substantive part (no prediction of G, locality, connection/curvature, Yang-Mills dynamics); the motivating bridge is circular (R019 class B). (Superselection) strictly weaker than WWW/DHR, which DERIVE which charges superselect from the commutant and produce the Hilbert-space sector decomposition; SBT does neither and has no spin-statistics (R022 class C). (SSB) mixed: the F15a no-go RECOVERS the long-known impossibility of symmetric vacuum selection (already in Goldstone/Anderson and Gribov-Singer) but is genuinely more general and Lean-audited (R020 class C). The ONE place U014 partially beats deflation is this F15a no-go: 'an equivariant deterministic selector under a nontrivial degenerate orbit lands only in the common fixed locus' is rigid, Lean-certified, and opposite-world INELASTIC. So the compression is real and broad (one criterion across >=4 selection rules) but as physics it is a relabel everywhere except that narrow already-known no-go.

The net: the 'compression' from N selection rules to 1 mechanism is real ONLY at the bookkeeping/form level; the physics-bearing data (which orbit, which group, sector-purity, the breaker) are N separate imports, one per domain, so there is essentially NO compression of empirical assumptions -- only of the descent formalism.

audit.audit_verdict: MERELY-REPACKAGES with ONE genuine rigid corollary. U014's shared mechanism -- the split-pair-emptiness biconditional (F2/F15a) -- IS precisely 'quotient-by-fibers / orbit-descent', which the frozen domain_tension_ledger names as one of the three textbook lemmas SBT's six mechanisms allegedly collapse to. So by construction it largely does NOT beat the deflation critique: it is the lemma in costume. COMPRESSION audit: LOW. The biconditional is analytic (true in every world for any declared q), so it carries bookkeeping form, not physics; empirical assumptions are not compressed because each of the four-plus legs imports its own physics datum (the orbit/group for conservation, the circular OI-EI bridge for gauge, sector-purity + phase-unobservability for superselection, the declared breaker for SSB, the diffeo group for GR). Formal saving is marginal (assumptions ~8->6, params ~9->7) and offset by N per-leg hidden imports. BASELINE comparison: strictly weaker on physics than every standard account (Noether produces J^mu; Dirac/Weyl + Faddeev-Popov give A/G with dynamics; DHR derives which charges superselect and the sector decomposition; Goldstone/Anderson give the modes and effective potential), and weaker than EFT (no RG semigroup, no scales) and decoherence (no einselection; orbit/lens/breaker are FREE inputs, MISS_LENS_SEL). The genuine, non-vacuous value is twofold and modest: (i) a Lean-anchored cross-domain ORGANIZATIONAL compression of the descent FORM across >=4 selection rules plus Buridan/Schelling/hairy-ball, and (ii) a precise honesty AUDIT naming exactly which datum each rule smuggles. ANTI-SUPERFICIAL controls: 3 pass (same_word, bridge_map partial, surprise on one leg), 4 fail (shared_mechanism, hidden_import, elasticity, compression).
